queries: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS reference_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, o.reference_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE s.avg_modelconf > o.reference_avg), qualifying_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS reference_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.reference_avg AS above_average_by, q.avg_modelconf / a.reference_avg AS relative_to_qualifying_average FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_average a WHERE a.reference_avg IS NOT NULL AND a.reference_avg <> 0
